_about: Subset of the SAT CFDI 4.0 catalogues (Anexo 20) used to populate invoices.uso_cfdi / forma_pago / metodo_pago. DEV/EVAL ONLY - src/ must never import this.
primary_document: Anexo 20 - Guia de llenado de los CFDI (CFDI 4.0) and the catCFDI catalogue workbook
retrieval_limitation: Automated fetch of www.sat.gob.mx/consultas/13615 returned HTTP 403 and omawww.sat.gob.mx refused the connection on 2026-09-13. The SAT-hosted Anexo 20 PDF downloaded but its text layer is emitted glyph-by-glyph and could not be parsed within the time budget. Codes G01, G03, I01 and P01 and their descriptions were confirmed from SAT-hosted Anexo 20 documents surfaced by search; the remaining entries below are reproduced from the published catalogue definitions and are used as FORMAT REALISM only. They are not asserted to be a current, complete snapshot of catCFDI.

c_UsoCFDI.I02: Mobiliario y equipo de oficina por inversiones

consistency_rules_applied_in_the_generat: metodo_pago = PPD implies forma_pago = 99 ('Por definir'), per the Anexo 20 filling rule. This is a VALID combination and the estate contains many of them on purpose, so that a detector treating forma_pago 99 as suspicious produces a false positive.
metodo_pago = PUE implies a concrete forma_pago (01, 02, 03, 04, 28).
invoices.status uses the estate enum vigente | cancelado (estate_schema.sql), not the SAT cancellation-status vocabulary.

iva_rates_used.0.08: Reduced rate applied to taxpayers under the northern border region fiscal stimulus. Used for a small number of vendors domiciled in border municipalities so that total = subtotal * 1.16 is NOT a universally safe check.
iva_rates_used.0.00: Exempt / zero-rated supplies (for example certain foodstuffs and medical services). Used for a small number of vendors for the same reason.
